title: 1:1 prep - Isabel Cruz (weekly)
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Avery Brooks
Date: 2026-03-03
Time: 10:00am PT
Location: Zoom / Slack huddle

Purpose: quick sync on current priorities, unblockers, career check-in, and expectations for next sprint. Keep to 30 min.

Agenda (proposed):
- 2 min quick personal check-in (how's energy, context switching)
- 8 min project status: KV-cache rollout + perf regression alerts
- 6 min blockers & resourcing needs (oncall load, infra quota)
- 6 min career / growth (what I want to work on next 6-12 weeks)
- 6 min actions / decisions / follow-ups

Wins (to mention):
- KV-cache rollout: staged traffic shift to v2 on dedicated clusters completed for canary (10% traffic) last week. Metrics: tail latency down ~12% for 2k seq workload in canary.
- Closed GH#512 (cache eviction bug) with hotfix; tests added to prevent regression.
- Pairing session with Morgan on kernel selection heuristics - helpful for perf triage.

Current work / status notes:
- KV-cache rollout (primary): status = canary at 10%. Next step: increase to 30% after 48h and no alerts. Observability dashboards updated (Confluence: kv-cache-rollout-plan).
- INF-3421 (prefetch scheduling): implemented initial scheduler changes; unit tests green, integration flakiness still appears on long-seq tests. Working with infra to repro stable environment.
- Oncall: 2 pager shifts this week; still seeing some bursts from offline batch joins - investigating mitigation with rate-limiter.

Blockers / risks to bring up:
- Need approval for a short-term infra quota bump on dedicated-dev (need +2 GPU nodes) to run more stable integration tests for INF-3421. Cost is estimated at ~$1.2k for 2 weeks.
- Persistent flakiness for sequence-length > 4k in integration tests; appears in perf harness only. Suspect OOM in kv cache path when prefetch + large batch combine. Need time + infra to bisect.
- Prioritization: I think we should delay non-critical linting cleanup task (GH#487) until rollout stabilizes - low risk but eats cycles.

Questions / discussion items for Avery:
- Agree on quota bump? If yes, who signs off (infra/product?) and timeline to provision?
- Tradeoff on rollout speed: continue 48h cadence -> 30% -> 60% vs slower 72h; what's your preference given upcoming demo next week?
- Career: I'd like to take on more ownership around model routing policies (policy + rollout playbooks). Ask for mentorship or a short project to own end-to-end.

Career / growth items (ask for specific feedback):
- Want feedback on my communication when incidents happen - did I provide clear decision points during last week's hotfix?
- Request for small stretch: lead a short doc + demo on routing fallback policies to product/console team (2-3 weeks).

Notes to self (things to say):
- Emphasize measured rollout and data: bring latency/cost graphs, error rates at 10% canary.
- Keep ask simple: quota approval + timeline + one decision on rollout speed.
- If Avery pushes for faster rollout, propose compromise: increase to 30% (48h) but hold off on 60% until infra bump done.

Action items (proposed, to confirm in meeting):
- Isabel: prepare a 1-slide summary with key metrics (latency percentiles, error rate, cost delta) for canary by EOD 2026-03-03.
- Avery: follow up on infra quota approval and confirm approver (expected by 2026-03-04).
- Morgan: help run the extended integration sweep once quota is provisioned (tentative: 2026-03-05).
- Isabel: create a short postmortem template for any regression seen during rollout and add to Confluence (due 2026-03-06).

Backlog / longer-term asks to raise if time:
- More visibility into Dedicated autoscale policies - request a small cross-team sync with infra and product to discuss autoscale triggers and SLOs.
- Desire to rotate away from some oncall shifts in 6 weeks - start planning coverage and handover.

Draft follow-up note to send after 1:1 (copy into Slack):
- Quick recap + decisions: quota bump approved? rollout cadence? action owners + dates. Attach the 1-slide summary.

Misc scratch / personal reminders:
- Remember to ask about travel budget for conf in May (ModelOps summit).
- Bring up interest in mentorship program (formal).
- Keep the tone concise and solution-oriented; manager prefers clear asks.
